name: falsify_truncated_input
description: FALSIFICATION of the verdict, input side. Identical to player_standard_5 except that playback is restricted to the first 7 clip seconds, so the scene opens (skill tab) and never closes: recognition is incomplete and no record.json is written. The runner must report FAIL with the whole golden removed, not a vacuous pass. sync is off because the annotated stops at frames 161 and 273 lie outside the range and would never fire; record_wait is short because the point is the absence of a record, not how long to hope for one.
